description: Add a whole number of days, weeks, or working_days to a date. amount may be negative. unit weeks is seven calendar days: 3 weeks from Friday 2026-10-23 is 2026-11-13. unit working_days skips Saturday, Sunday, and that country's national public holidays, and the start date is not counted: 10 working days from Friday 2026-10-23 is 2026-11-06 when none of those weekdays is a holiday. country is required for working_days. For days and weeks it is optional and is not used in the arithmetic. The result is the landing date, its weekday, iso_week, and us_week. The request date, amount, unit, and country are not repeated. Holiday dates are the bundled vacanza/holidays list (MIT) for 2026, 2027, and 2028. A walk that leaves those years returns an error.

amount.description: Whole number of units to add. Negative walks backward.

country.description: Required when unit is working_days. ISO code or English country name.

name: add_days

alternatives.description: Other cities that matched the same name, after the best-ranked city was chosen. The order is the site search order: match, then priority, then population.

weeks.description: ISO week (Monday start; week 1 contains the year's first Thursday) and US week (Sunday start; 1 January is week 1 of that calendar year).

title: Add days, weeks, or working days
